author: Fdw
name: Fdw Reference Service Type (aggregation + service type)
description: Creates a reference implementation of an FDW service kind as a PAIR of projects: the aggregation, and the service-type registration that registers it. The service-type project references the aggregation, so referencing it brings the aggregation with it; referencing the aggregation alone gets the composition and none of the registration.

ImplName.description: The kind being implemented (e.g. MsSql, Sqlite, Http, AzureKeyVault)

ServiceName.description: The service domain, singular (e.g. Connection, SecretManager, Notification)

ServiceNamePlural.description: The FDW package/namespace segment for the domain, usually plural (e.g. Connections, SecretManagers, Notifications)

FdwVersion.description: The Fdw.* package version to consume. Lockstep across the workspace; do not derive it from git.
